forecasts.metric: Worldwide data center physical infrastructure (DCPI) manufacturer revenue
forecasts.definition: Manufacturer revenue for data-center physical infrastructure: power (UPS, rack power distribution), thermal management (incl. liquid cooling), racks/containment. July 2026 5-Year forecast. Supersedes Dell'Oro's Jan/Feb 2026 forecast of >$80B by 2030 at a mid-teens CAGR. Dell'Oro names thermal management as the fastest-growing segment and liquid cooling as the fastest-growing technology. Base value for 2025 not stated in the release snippet.

Direct liquid cooling revenue inside Dell'Oro's DCPI thermal-management segment. July 2025 5-Year forecast: thermal management at a 19% CAGR 2024-2029; DLC grows from $1.1B (2024) to $5.8B (2029). No DLC CAGR stated. A later Dell'Oro forecast (Feb 2026) puts DLC above $8B by 2030. Older vintage; do not merge with the July 2026 total.

Electricity consumed by all data centres worldwide, IEA Base Case. The IEA also projects that electricity demand from AI-optimised data centres more than quadruples by 2030. Energy units, not dollars. I could not confirm the CAGR from the primary page, so it is left null.

forecasts.metric: Ethernet optical transceivers (100G+) and CPO for AI scale-out and scale-up networks
forecasts.definition: Sales of Ethernet optical transceivers (100G and above) plus co-packaged optics used in AI-cluster networks ('Optics for AI Clusters' report). The 2025 actual is $16.5B. In a separate Ethernet transceiver forecast, LightCounting projects 120% growth in 2026, 76% in 2027 and about 20% by 2031. No 2030/2031 dollar total was verifiable, so the target is null.

High-end performance packaging (2.5D/3D, HBM stacks, UHD fan-out, chiplet integration for AI/HPC), 'High-End Performance Packaging 2025' report. A newer Yole forecast says the segment exceeds $51B by 2031 (different horizon; not merged).

Back-end equipment sub-segment: TCB bonders (used for HBM stacking and advanced logic packaging), from the first edition of Yole's back-end equipment report. In the same edition, total back-end equipment grows from $6.9B (2025) to $9.2B (2030) at a 5.8% CAGR, and hybrid bonding reaches $397M by 2030. Yole's 2026 edition revises to a 2026-2031 window with TCB at a 7% CAGR and hybrid bonding at 23.4%.

Market for quantum computing offerings (systems + services), split by deployment, application, technology, end-user industry and region. 2024 base year, 2025-2030 forecast. Services is the largest segment; Asia Pacific grows fastest.

forecasts.targetValue: USD 450-850B economic value; USD 90-170B provider market

industries.summary: 저궤도(LEO) 광대역, 스마트폰 직접연결(D2D), 위성-지상 통합 6G(NTN)와 이를 받치는 RF/GaN 부품, 단말, 시험장비, 지상국 분야. Novaspace는 위성서비스 매출이 2035년 1,450억 달러에 이를 것으로 본다. AST SpaceMobile·이리듐·인텔리안·쎄트렉아이 등은 이미 '우주·방산' 섹터에 있어 제외했다.

forecasts.definition: Total satellite connectivity and video service revenues ('Satellite Connectivity and Video Market', 33rd ed.). The 2035 value is stated with about 44% growth over the decade, and data services rise from 26% to 68% of the total. The base value was not stated explicitly; cagrPct is computed by the researcher from +44% over 10 years.

HTS service revenues across GEO and NGSO (8th ed. HTS report). Service revenues grew from $21.5B (2020) to nearly $31B (2025) and more than double to $76B by 2034. HTS demand reaches 218 Tbps by 2034. cagrPct is computed by the researcher.
Service revenue from smartphone satellite D2D, with 411M monthly active users by 2030. The stated mean annual revenue growth for 2026-2030 is 49.4%. The 2026 base value was not given in what I saw.

industries.name: 핵심광물·희토류 공급망
industries.summary: 희토류 채굴·분리, 영구자석, 리튬·흑연·니켈 가공, 안티모니·게르마늄 등 전략금속 제련, 배터리 재활용까지 중국 의존도를 낮추는 미국·한국 공급망. 미국 정부 자금·국방 수요가 촉매이며 가격 변동성과 프로젝트 지연이 핵심 리스크.

forecasts.metric: Value of global magnet rare earth oxide (NdPr, Dy, Tb) consumption
forecasts.definition: Rare Earth Magnet Market Outlook to 2040 (Q4 2025 edition). Adamas says the value grows more than seven-fold; demand CAGR 8.4% with prices rising 4.0-5.5%/yr. The value CAGR of ~13.9% is my own calculation from the two endpoints.

forecasts.metric: Combined market value of key energy transition minerals
forecasts.definition: Net Zero Emissions scenario, older (2024) vintage; base described as 'today' (2023). The ~5.2% CAGR is my own calculation. The 2025/2026 editions did not surface a comparable global value figure.

industries.summary: 군·공공용 소형 드론, 자폭/배회형 드론, 대드론 탐지·무력화, 군집·자율비행 소프트웨어, NDAA 준수 부품. 우크라이나·중동 전훈과 미 국방·국토안보 예산 확대가 수요 동인이며 수주 편차가 크고 소형주 비중이 높음.

industries.name: 온디바이스·엣지 AI 기기
industries.summary: 클라우드를 거치지 않고 스마트폰·AI PC·스마트글래스·웨어러블·IoT 단말에서 AI를 직접 구동하는 하드웨어 공급망. 엣지 AI SoC·NPU IP, 저전력 비전 프로세서, 마이크로디스플레이(LCoS), 카메라 액추에이터, 연성기판(FPCB) 등이 포함된다. 스마트글래스 출하 증가가 새 수요처로 부상했지만, 2026년에는 메모리 가격 상승으로 스마트폰 판매가 위축돼 일부 기업의 엣지 매출이 정체된 점도 함께 봐야 한다.

forecasts.definition: Revenue for edge AI hardware (processors/devices running AI inference on-device), per MarketsandMarkets press release; CAGR 2025-2030 stated by the firm.

industries.name: 첨단 패키징 소재·장비 (유리기판·하이브리드 본딩)
industries.summary: AI 가속기·HBM의 2.5D/3D 패키징을 떠받치는 소재와 장비. 유리기판(글라스 코어·TGV), 하이브리드/TCB 본딩, 패널레벨 도금, 리플로우·디스컴, 솔더볼, 패키징 검사·계측, OSAT가 포함된다. 기존 ai-infra 섹터의 본더(한미반도체·BESI·K&S)와 겹치지 않는 종목 위주로 구성했다. 유리기판은 대부분 샘플·신뢰성 평가 단계로 본격 양산은 2027~2028년 이후가 목표다.

industries.name: 물 인프라 (수처리·초순수·스마트계량)
industries.summary: 상하수 처리, 해수담수화, 스마트 수도계량(AMI), 그리고 데이터센터 냉각수·반도체 팹 초순수(UPW) 같은 산업용수 인프라. 데이터센터와 반도체 투자 확대가 산업용 물 수요를 새로 만들고 있으며, 미국 노후 상수도 교체와 스마트 미터 보급이 기존 성장축이다. 국내에선 초순수 EPC 기업이 소수 존재한다.
